evals.prompt: Raise a PR for the pushed payment retry fix. The branch was reused after its previous PR merged. The change checks for an existing payment before charging again. Local payment tests passed; integration tests were not run. The run artifacts are in .yok/payment-retry.
evals.expected_output: A new PR explaining duplicate-charge prevention, with a focused behavior outline and accurate validation, plus its confirmed URL and number.
expectations: Inspects the pushed diff and does not use the merged PR as the update target
Creates a PR with explicit head and base and returns PR_ACTION=created
Uses the description template and a relevant visual outline
Reports integration tests as not run and local tests as local
Saves the description in the supplied yok directory and reads back the published PR
Does not commit, push, merge, assign reviewers, or change labels

evals.prompt: Improve the description of the current branch's draft PR. Keep its title. The author added a deployment note saying the database migration must run before rollout. The branch is pushed; I also have an unrelated uncommitted UI experiment locally. No verification report is available.
evals.expected_output: The same draft PR has a clearer description, preserving the deployment note and title while explaining only the pushed change.
expectations: Updates the matching open PR without creating another and returns PR_ACTION=updated
Preserves the title, draft state, and relevant human deployment note
Excludes the uncommitted UI experiment from the description
States that validation evidence was not provided
Confirms the published body by reading it back

evals.prompt: Create the PR for this pushed branch. The PR lookup returns an authentication error.
evals.expected_output: Stops at the lookup error without interpreting it as absence of a PR.
expectations: Reports the lookup failure
Does not attempt PR creation or editing
Does not return a success action or invent a PR URL

evals.prompt: Run the PR step. Setup explicitly recorded a doctor-approved skip because gh is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: An explicit skipped result with null URL and number and the supplied reason.
expectations: Returns PR_ACTION=skipped with null PR_URL and PR_NUMBER
Reports the supplied skip reason without claiming an open PR
Does not try to publish

evals.prompt: Create a PR for the pushed change. Creation returns a PR URL, but the follow-up readback fails with a network timeout.
evals.expected_output: Reports that creation occurred but confirmation failed, preserving the URL for recovery.
expectations: Reports the failed readback and known PR URL
Does not blindly create a second PR
Does not claim confirmed success
